text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown managed to secure victory 
somehow. However, she felt threatened by 
the tenacity that Kitasan Black displayed 
during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to the Satono Group's analytical 
tech, Kitasan Black was right in the 
middle of a growth spurt. It seemed she 
wouldn't reach her peak until next spring 
or later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing the birth of a generational 
monster, Satono Crown's heart beats fast 
with excitement. She wears a smile, 
determined to overcome this new rival.
